scope: Targeted novelty re-audit of the 20 fixed source SHAs, including all-state upstream PR file indexes and pre-existing fork heads.

method.enumeration: REST /repos/rasbt/mlxtend/pulls?state=all&per_page=100, all eight pages through the empty page; not the issue-search wrapper.
method.file_index: All 684 PR /files responses fully paginated. Large-PR details were checked against changed_files; no missing pages or omitted patches for targeted production paths.
method.review: Mapped each exact production diff to all-state files, inspected relevant function changes, checked topic/title/body matches and earlier renamed/reorganized paths. Textual added-line overlap was only a lead, not the novelty decision.
method.old_fork_review: Refreshed all 35 non-20261115 heads: the 34 pre-existing heads plus the earlier validation/upstream-master reference. Compared each fixed head SHA with the campaign base and inspected every overlap with campaign production files.
method.limitations: The conclusion is no equivalent fix found in the retrieved public PR/fork history. It is not a claim about deleted or private branches, unpublished work outside these repositories, or future submissions.

result: No equivalent duplicate found; no delivered item removed in this re-audit.

items.title: Preserve NumPy item identifiers in association rules
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #1137 introduced the broad np.generic-to-int conversion. #1141/#1142 change missing-value/num_itemsets handling, #1157/#1158 change formatting, #1182 adds a metric, and #1250 suppresses a metric warning; none restrict conversion to NumPy integers. The earlier association/ path (#159) also contains no equivalent label-preservation fix.

items.title: Avoid integer overflow in Kmeans distance calculations
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #49 introduced subtraction/squaring in the original integer dtype; later changes do not promote operands before distance calculation. The old fork empty-cluster fix changes centroid recomputation only.

items.title: Keep Kmeans memberships consistent with the final centroids
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #48 introduced assignment before each centroid update, without a final assignment after exhausting max_iter. #50 adds convergence tolerance. The old fork empty-cluster fix does not synchronize final assignments.

items.title: Align frequent-pattern count thresholds with fractional support
items.decision: No equivalent change found for these three algorithms. #550/#553/#1020 introduce ceil(min_support*n) thresholds, #622/#1000 adjust sparse input access, and #1164 validates the support range. #1191 is related floating-boundary work but changes only Apriori's low_memory generator; it does not change FP-Growth, FP-Max, H-Mine, or their integer count conversion. This candidate fixes the three affected algorithms as one item.

items.title: Fix matching class weights in LDA between-class scatter
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #27 introduced X[y == i + 1] in between-class scatter while mean vectors use zero-based classes. #277 changes within-class scatter and adds decomposition/loadings; #478 sorts eigenvector columns. None correct the between-class sample weights.

items.title: Preserve sample alignment for k-fold paired t-test inputs
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #324 introduced direct X[train_index]/y[train_index] in paired_ttest_kfold_cv. #1242 adds a separate corrected-resampled t-test that uses safe indexing, but leaves paired_ttest_kfold_cv unchanged.

items.title: Match F-test p-values to the residual degrees of freedom
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #460 introduced denominator degrees (models-1)*samples even though residual mean square uses (models-1)*(samples-1). #1275 and the matching old fork branch optimize object-count enumeration without changing degrees of freedom.

items.title: Flatten multi-output stacking predictions into consistent meta-features
items.decision: No equivalent change found for probability-list flattening and CV multi-output predictions. #139 supports ordinary StackingClassifier multi-target class predictions; it does not flatten list-valued predict_proba outputs. #445's alternative stacking/ hierarchy still passes probability lists through np.asarray or shape access and reshapes CV predictions to one column. #513/#522/#532/#675 likewise retain single-output assumptions. #802 affects the regressor, not the two classifier paths.

items.title: Retain original class labels in OneR rules and predictions
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #727 bins original labels with np.bincount and allocates integer predictions. #790/#796 adjust deprecated integer dtypes. #1276 and its old fork branch only fix chi-squared feature tie selection; label encoding, original-label rules, and prediction dtype remain unchanged.

items.title: Apply the one-standard-error rule to parsimonious SFS selection
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #240 introduces the parsimonious rule using each candidate's std/n and a moving best-score threshold; #965 moves the same formula to finalize_fit. #963 preserves it. #886/#1160 add early stopping, not a fixed threshold based on the best subset's SEM.

items.title: Avoid quadratic sample-space allocation in PCA SVD
items.decision: No equivalent change found. Historical SVD implementations retain full_matrices default True; #1080 changes NumPy to SciPy/gesvd, while #1010/#1011/#1012 only alter an error string. Existing fork PCA branches correct fitted centering and symmetric eigendecomposition, without changing SVD allocation. This candidate preserves the full feature basis for wide data.

items.title: Apply voting estimator replacements before nested parameter updates
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #254/#259 expose vote parameters through the stale cached named_clfs map. #515/#522 provide replacement handling for stacking classes, not EnsembleVoteClassifier. #834/#854 only update six iteration. #1292 and the old fork branch align prefit probability columns; they do not resolve named replacement or stale parameter maps.

items.title: Use n_scores minus one degrees of freedom for selector score intervals
items.decision: No equivalent change found. Both existing _calc_confidence implementations and the generic-selector proposals #834/#861 use t quantiles with len(scores), not len(scores)-1. #963 retains the same formula and #1165 changes result selection, not uncertainty computation. The two selectors are fixed together.

items.title: Preserve input arrays during permutation importance
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #358/#955 operate on the caller array and restore columns only on the successful path. #1142/#1229 correct which feature-group columns are permuted; neither makes a writable input copy or protects the caller array when callbacks raise.

items.title: Center RBF kernel matrices with in-place mean subtraction
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #28 introduces dense one_n dot products for training-kernel centering and later changes preserve them. The old fork kernel-pca-projection branch centers the cross-kernel at transform time and stores training means, while retaining the original dense training centering products.

items.title: Ignore NaN candidate means when ranking sequential feature subsets
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #211 changes means to nanmean but leaves argmax over potentially all-NaN candidate means. #640 changes cross_val_score(error_score=-inf), which does not address scorer-produced NaN means or candidate ranking generally. #963/#965 retain plain argmax and #1160 guards an early-stopping comparison, not candidate selection.

items.title: Infer GroupTimeSeriesSplit fold counts before the first split
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #915 adds get_n_splits as a return of self.n_splits. #1113 changes plotting. #1273 resets constructor parameters for reuse after split(), but still returns None when get_n_splits is called before the first split without explicit n_splits.

items.title: Preserve global maximality when limiting FPMax itemset lengths
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #553 limits recursion at max_len without retaining frequent-extension evidence for maximality; #692 corrects path support values, #1000 handles sparse input, #1193 changes a default description, and #1198 is documentation about maximal itemsets/association-rule limitations. None repair the length-boundary maximality cache.

items.title: Preserve cross-validation metadata routing across feature-selection workers
items.decision: No equivalent metadata-routing change found. #350/#354/#537 provide legacy fit_params/groups forwarding. #1109 selects params versus fit_params by sklearn version but still passes groups directly and uses joblib Parallel. #963 proposes a custom weighted CV implementation with fixed StratifiedKFold, not sklearn metadata routing. #1245 changes serial interruption/progress; #1255 preserves DataFrames. None route groups through params with routing enabled and propagate sklearn config into parallel tasks.

items.title: Resolve named stacking replacements before removing estimators
items.decision: No equivalent change found. #515 introduces the helper and deletes individual estimators while later replacements still use original indices. #522 adopts the helper for other stacking classes. #834/#854 adjust dict iteration and #914 reformats it. None resolve all named replacements before filtering removals.
